Kodiaq

Build your own
The Škoda Kodiaq boasts a powerful and rugged appearance 
with a redesigned front grille, squared-off wheel arches and 
solid rear bumper to give it a real road presence. The new 
design also improves aerodynamics and increased efficiency 
and as always is packed with simply clever features and even 
more space to provide the most comfortable drive.
The exterior introduces the first elements of Modern Solid 
design language and includes new technologies such as  
Full LED Matrix headlights and a horizontal light strip across 
the grille.
The new interior concept combines sustainable materials  
and spacious design with innovative controls such as the  
new Škoda Smart Dials.
Offering the right option for every customer: power outputs 
from 150 PS to 204 PS and a plug-in hybrid drivetrain with  
an electric range of up to 76 miles.

Innovation with intent 
The interior of the all-new Kodiaq combines style and simplicity with smart solutions and intuitive controls. 
The virtual cockpit and 13” infotainment display give an immediate sense of ease and luxury.
The DSG gear selector is positioned on the steering column, allowing for a generous centre console. 
Above which you’ll find customisable Škoda Smart Dials, which combine physical dials and digital displays 
to intuitively access a range of vehicle functions.
Models shown are not UK specification. Some of the equipment shown is optional.
Dual wireless charging
Arrive at your destination ready to go 
with a fully-charged smartphone
*
. Simply 
place your compatible smartphone on the 
wireless charging pad to start receiving 
power. Plus, the cooling function will help 
prevent your phone from overheating.
Škoda Smart Dials
Combining practical haptic control 
with innovative digital technology. 
The two outer Smart Dials allow for easy 
function of the interior temperature, 
seat heating and ventilation. Whilst the 
centre dial can control up to four other 
functions, such as driving modes, 
map zoom, and speaker volume.
CANTON sound system
Set the perfect tone for every journey 
with this set of 12 speakers and digital 
equaliser. Created in collaboration with 
German audio experts CANTON, you can 
be confident every album, radio show or 
podcast will be pitch perfect as the 
system has been fine-tuned to suit the 
all-new Kodiaq’s interior.
* Charging speeds up to 15w. Performance of smartphone 
can also affect charging speed.

Plug into the future
The Kodiaq will offer a plug-in hybrid variant 
for the 1st time. With a range of over  
70 miles across all trims our flagship SUV is  
the perfect all rounder for all family trips.

iV badging
The Kodiaq remains understated 
with small iV badging, which can 
be removed free of charge.
Drive mode select
A choice of settings to suit all conditions 
and driving styles; SPORT mode provides 
the maximum power output of 204 
PS, whilst in E-mode, the Kodiaq iV is 
powered exclusively by the battery.  
In HYBRID mode, the electronics optimise 
the balance between the petrol engine 
and the electric motor.
Charging
The battery is capable of up to 40kW 
DC charging, taking the charge level 
from 10% to 80% in just 26 minutes.
It is also capable of up to 11kW AC 
charging, meaning it can be charged at  
a home wallbox in as little as 2.30 hours. 
Range
The Kodiaq iV can travel over 
70 miles (112km) on a single charge, 
meaning the majority of journeys could 
be completed in pure electric driving.

SmartLink enables you to connect  
your smartphone through the 
infotainment system with Apple 
CarPlay™ and Android Auto™ as 
standard across the range.
Virtual cockpit
Put all the information you need right in 
front of your eyes with the customisable

traditional instrument dials and can

A fifth Sports view is available for

wherever you go
By enabling you to be fully online on the move, the

shortcuts to take and routes to avoid.
Škoda connect 
& Navigation system
The new Škoda Connect system 
turns the Kodiaq into a fully 
interconnected car. Infotainment 
Online provides satellite navigation, 
traffic reports and calendar updates. 
With Proactive Services the car 
will contact your Škoda Retailer to 
arrange a service.  
Finally, Emergency Call will contact 
the emergency services in the event 
of an accident to get you the help you 
need. All at your finger tips on the 
new free standing 13" infotainment 
navigation touchscreen display and 
integrated Wi-Fi will get you from  
A to B, but why stop there? 
With its Bluetooth®, SmartLink 
and Wi-Fi capability, it offers more 
connectivity on-the-go.

Pedestrian monitor 
Whether it’s a child chasing a loose ball 
or an adult glued to their smartphone 
screen, if someone unexpectedly crosses 
your path the Pedestrian Monitor 
automatically reduces your car’s speed 
to help prevent a collision.
On the lookout
With a host of camera and radar-based 
assistance systems making continual 
assessments, you’ll have peace of mind - 
wherever you’re driving.
Driving assistance
The onboard camera recognises key traffic 
signs and automatically adjusts it's speed as 
well as automatically mirroring the speed of 
the vehicle in front for ultimate ease when 
driving on the motorway. Also features lane 
keeping system and traffic jam assist.
Full LED Matrix headlights
See more of the road ahead with the 
adaptive front light system, cornering 
function, all weather lighting system and 
integrated headlight washers.
Blind spot detect
An extra set of eyes on the road that 
monitors the blind spots allowing you to 
manoeuvre safely.
Park assist 
This function removes the stress of reverse 
and parallel parking by identifying if the 
parking spot is big enough before 
automatically steering into the space for 
you. Trained parking is a new feature where 
the vehicle automatically completes a 
parking manoeuvre for you in a familiar 
environment, e.g at home.
Multi-collision brake
In the unthinkable event you have an 
accident in your Kodiaq, the Multi-
Collision Brake system will automatically 
slow the car to help protect you from any 
further collisions.
Always looking out for your safety

Service intervals
When you order your Kodiaq, you can choose whether your car is on a fixed or 
a flexible service regime. Your Škoda retailer will help you decide which regime 
suits how your car will be driven, enabling your car to stay in the best possible 
shape.
Fixed regime: service every 10,000 miles or one year (whichever comes first).
This is recommended if the vehicle is likely to be used in the following way:
>   Driven fewer than 10,000 miles per annum. 
>   Mainly short journeys, driven mostly in towns or cities.
>   High vehicle loading/towing and frequent hill climbs.
>   Heavy accelerating and braking, using high revs.
Flexible regime: Sensors in the engine detect when a service is needed. A service 
light will show between 9,000 and 20,000 miles or up to 24 months (whichever 
comes first).
The flexible service regime is recommended for vehicles with a daily mileage of 
more than 25 miles where the vehicle is driven regularly and mainly at a constant 
speed with minimum vehicle and engine loading, minimal towing and driven in an 
economical manner.
